psychological_meaning: Thunder evokes feelings of strength, resilience, and a touch of melancholy. It represents power and the ability to weather storms, both literally and figuratively, suggesting stability and a grounded nature. This color conveys a sense of depth and quiet determination, often associated with introspection and a thoughtful approach to life.
